law.purpose: P-71(3) slice B step 1 (r143 item 5, sandbox-first r103/r111/r123/r137/r141 pattern): the director state (engine-mirrored r144) drives a CLOSED-BAND multiplicative modulation of exactly two existing visual channels. This manifest = the single parameter source for the r146 engine round; assertion gate logs/devloop-r146-moodvisual-test.ps1 (v0.2 re-derivation of the r145 gate).
law.no_decoration_law: mood is 100% real-data derived (events 24h >= DenseDefault 12 / law-source festivals with legal pointers / deep-night window / WEATHER_ALERT + somber weather kinds) - the modulation inherits that traceability; zero invented states, zero timed decorative loops (DESIGN sec.7).
law.five_color_law: every modulation value is a single grayscale scalar (equal-RGB brightness multiplier) - structurally hue-free. Functional light colors, ambient palettes, tint quads and every proof-baseline hue are untouched.
law.zero_drift_law: steady AND somber rows are exactly 1.0 on every channel (the baseline never drifts; somber's visual IS the existing r13 ALERT red band + rain/snow field - linkage without new construction, r143 law).
law.render_physics_law: r146 engine evidence: SpriteRenderer.color RGB above 1.0 clamps at the render-path INPUT in this LDR / Built-in sprite pipeline - a x2.0 grayscale tint moved 0 window pixels while 17970 sub-saturated (0.05..0.87 luminance) sampled pixels stood in the modulated windows (night-tier repeat: 0 moved, 18436 stood). A multiplicative tint can therefore ONLY dim; the neon channel's renderable domain is [0.85, 1.0]. The v0.1 up-band rows (lively 1.10 / festive 1.15) are FALSIFIED and re-derived to 1.0 - physically inert values never stay on the table. Dimming is proven live: hushed 0.85 moved 150+ px with a negative signed mean. Up-mood energy (lively/festive) rides the breath channel (real alpha 0.8 -> 0.92); NeonProof D2 enforces the clamp law - pixel motion under any >1 tint means the render path changed and the table must be re-derived, never a faked brightening.
law.ceo_pulse_precedence: effective breath peak = PeakAlpha(0.8) x breath_peak_scale must stay strictly below the CEO pulse MaxAlpha(0.95): max scale 1.15 -> 0.92 < 0.95. The CEO light is never outranked by ambient choreography.
law.exempt_family_law: the MountExempt structure family (4 signs: NeonTowerAntM/L/R r132 crown needles - CEO throne pin always-on + fleet pins - plus NeonAntenna, the QUANT rooftop lattice antenna, r87 exempt precedent) is tower/antenna structure, NOT street mood scenery: excluded from neon modulation. Modulated set = 21 - 4 = 17 signs.
law.degrade_law: mood absent (calendar null / world-state absent / events stream unreadable / unknown mood string) => steady row (x1.0 everywhere, grandfather face, honest silence - MoodDirector null law r144).
law.proof_surface_law: channels deliberately avoid AmbientTint / sky palette / skyline fog (AmbientProof + CameraProof baselines stay untouched); the engine face applies runtime-only and restores neutral white before any scene save (r124 runtime law).

neon_intensity.carrier: NeonRules table sprites (persistent scene objects) - runtime sr.color grayscale multiplier, white = neutral; renderable domain is dim-only [0.85, 1.0] (render_physics_law)
neon_intensity.exempt_family: MountExempt structure family: NeonTowerAntM/L/R (r132 crown needles) + NeonAntenna (QUANT rooftop lattice, r87 exempt precedent)

breath_peak_scale.carrier: EventRouter.BreathGlow per-OS-round ring (OS_TICK_START ramp-in / OS_TICK_DONE ramp-out, one breathe per 10-min city round)
